card.name: Every/each before year, day, season
card.fires_on: The words every or each right after a clause, when they start a recurring time phrase such as every year, every day, every June or every Spring.

modes.label: Recurring event
modes.description: Every or each introduces how often an annual event or season happens.
modes.example: The FASF is held<< every>> Spring.

modes.label: Rate per period
modes.description: Each or every starts a time unit after a count or a statement of frequency.
modes.example: accounting for 22% of the total 1.24 million road traffic deaths<< each>> year.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Every
modes.description: Capitalized Every opens a sentence about what happens yearly.
modes.example: International Women’s Day 2013 <<Every>> year the United Nations chooses a theme for

card.writes: It suppresses further forms of each/every in several languages, so the model avoids repeating the word and moves on to the time unit.
card.plain: It fires on 'every' or 'each' when they introduce a repeating time like every year or every day.
